map.🧠 眼底(C/D比)与视神经评估器: 🧠 Fundus (C/D Ratio) and Optic Nerve Assessor
map.输入双眼垂直杯盘比(C/D)，评估青光眼视神经损害、不对称性与 ISNT 规则。: Enter vertical cup-disc ratio (C/D) of both eyes to assess glaucoma optic-nerve damage, asymmetry and the ISNT rule.
map.📖 查看「眼底(C/D比)与视神经评估器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Fundus (C/D Ratio) and Optic Nerve Assessor User Guide"
map.杯盘比 C/D 取 0 至 1；青光眼风险 = C/D 大于 0.5 或 双眼差: Cup-disc ratio C/D ranges 0 to 1; glaucoma risk = C/D > 0.5 or inter-eye difference > 0.2 or violation of ISNT rule (superior>=nasal, nasal>=inferior, inferior>=temporal); any one met suggests optic-nerve change needing further assessment.
map.ISNT 规则：正常盘沿下方>上方>鼻侧>颞侧；下方/上方盘沿变薄提示青光眼。盘: ISNT rule: normal rim inferior>superior>nasal>temporal; inferior/superior rim thinning suggests glaucoma. Disc size affects C/D interpretation.
map.⚠️ C/D 评估受盘大小、屈光影响，需结合 OCT、视野与眼压综合判断，建议眼: ⚠️ C/D assessment is affected by disc size and refraction; combine OCT, visual field and IOP for judgment; recommend ophthalmology follow-up.
map.对垂直杯盘比进行分级并校验 ISNT 规则与双眼不对称性，辅助青光眼视神经评估。: Grades vertical cup-disc ratio and validates the ISNT rule and inter-eye asymmetry, aiding glaucoma optic-nerve assessment.
map.输入视盘杯/盘比 OD、OS 评估青光眼视神经改变。: Enter optic-disc cup/disc ratio OD, OS to assess glaucoma optic-nerve change.
map.不对称 = |0.6−0.3| = 0.3 > 0.2，且 OD>0.5，提示青: Asymmetry = |0.6-0.3| = 0.3 > 0.2, and OD>0.5, suggests glaucoma optic-nerve change to investigate.
map.不对称 0、均 <0.5，未见明显异常，但需结合 RNFL 与视野。: Asymmetry 0, both <0.5, no obvious abnormality, but combine RNFL and visual field.
map.单眼 >0.5 或双眼差 >0.2 为可疑，须结合视野与 OCT-RNFL。: Single eye >0.5 or inter-eye difference >0.2 is suspect, must combine visual field and OCT-RNFL.
map.正常视盘颞侧最薄、上方/下方较厚（Inferior>Superior>Nasal: Normal disc temporal thinnest, superior/inferior thicker (Inferior>Superior>Nasal>Temporal) rhythm; violation suggests glaucoma.
